scope: manual_timetable_templates where serviceDate=ANY(operating_dates); source resolution joined by source_template_id; NOT full network
sourceSql:
select m.id::text as source_id, m.line_key, m.railway_urn,m.calendar_urn,m.direction_urn,m.train_number,m.train_type_urn,m.source_trip_id,
m.source_path,m.source_revision_date::text as source_revision_date,
s.mapping_level,s.vehicle_type as sql_vehicle_type,s.vehicle_artwork_path as sql_png_path,
s.timetable_validity
from public.manual_timetable_templates m
join public.train_timetable_source_resolution s on s.source_template_id=m.id
where '2026-11-16'::date=any(m.operating_dates)
order by m.line_key,m.train_number,m.id
